name: Roosevelt and Rondon on the River of Doubt
summary: The Brazilian engineer Rondon, who had strung telegraph lines across Mato Grosso, and the former U.S. president descend an unmapped river of a thousand kilometres. Rapids wreck the canoes, one man drowns, another is murdered, and Roosevelt nearly dies of fever; the river is renamed the Rio Roosevelt.

stops.note: The expedition sets out north across the plateau.
Seven canoes launch on the River of Doubt.
Weeks of portages; a canoe and the paddler Simplício are lost.
Down the Madeira to the Amazon.

informs.note: The River of Doubt is mapped
